title: Harissa (Armenian Wheat Porridge)
description: A classic dish from Armenia, featuring whole chicken, wheat berries, unsalted butter. A practical home-kitchen version with measured step ingredients and clear cooking methods.

steps.instruction: Combine these ingredients in a pot, bring just to a boil and skim any foam. Simmer gently for about 145 minutes to make a flavorful base.
Shred or tear the cooked components, then fold together with the listed additions.
Combine the remaining ingredients, cover partly and stew gently for about 80 minutes until the flavors meld and everything is tender.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
